title: Te Tika i waenganui i ngā Kaihokohoko
intro: I tū tetahi āhua i mua i te iwi kua riro i te mānumanu o te moni, e karanga ana i a rātou ki te pono me te tika i roto i ā rātou mahi. I whakatūpato tēnei pononga a Allah kia kaua e whakaiti i te mehua me te whakarerekē i te pauna. I whakakahore te iwi ki te whakarongo, me te whakawehi ki te pei i tēnei tangata i tō rātou whenua. Ka ara ake te whenua ki te whakawa ki a rātou. Ko wai tēnei āhua i tū mō te tika i roto i ngā kaihokohoko?
clues: I tonoa ahau hei karere ki tētahi iwi e rumakina nui ana ki te mahi hokohoko me te hokohoko.
I poto te mehua a tōku iwi i a rātou e paunatia ana he taonga mā ētahi atu.
I whakawehi rātou kia peia ahau i te whenua mēnā ka tohe tonu ahau ki te karanga i a rātou ki te whakapono.
E maumaharatia ana ahau hei te tangata kōrero tino matatau i roto i ngā poropiti.
I pāngia tōku iwi e te rū whenua nui, ā, i mate ai rātou i roto i ō rātou kāinga.
I tonoa ahau ki te iwi o Madyan i te raki o Hijaz.

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰشُعَيْبُ أَصَلَوٰتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَن نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَآ أَوْ أَن نَّفْعَلَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِنَا مَا نَشَـٰٓؤُا۟ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ ٱلْحَلِيمُ ٱلرَّشِيدُ
verse: They said, "O Shuʿayb, does your prayer [i.e., religion] command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? Indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning!" (11:87)
